# maja

Ljubljana, Slovenia. 29. Trains for hypertrophy four days a week, almost
entirely on machines. The record runs from 2029-10-01 to 2030-06-30.

## What she is for

A setting is part of the measurement. The other strength records in this
corpus log an exercise, a load and some reps, which is enough for a barbell
and not enough for a machine: the same stack pin at seat position 3 and seat
position 5 is a different exercise on the same frame, and a leg press at 45
degrees is not a leg press at 30.

Her sets carry the seat, the pad, the lever and the angle. She writes them
down because she has twice been put on the wrong seat height by a helpful
stranger and could not tell afterwards whether the session was bad or the
chair was.

## Two machines, two kinds of number

The leg press is a plate-loaded sled and takes discs she can weigh, so its
number is kilograms and quantises to 2.5. The other three are selectorised:
the number is where a pin sits in a column, so it is a whole number with no
unit. Those two numbers cannot be added together, and her record does not let
them be.

## Food off a packet

She logs from the label, so her meals hold what the label states per hundred
grams - including fibre, sugar and sodium, which no other record in this
corpus has. The label is rounded before she ever sees it. That error arrives
with the packaging and cannot be removed by logging carefully, which is a
different kind of wrongness from a guess.

## A goal that is a band

Protein 130 to 160 g, both bounds declared. The top of it is not a failure.
